question_sufficiency_rationale: This implementation followed two already-reviewed PRDs and a concrete user instruction to proceed. The remaining decisions were low-risk backend foundation choices with explicit no-live-write, no-model-change, and no-production-change constraints.
stop_condition: Contract, tests, lane proof, source manifests, and proof dashboard pass.

goal_artifact.summary: Goal is a first backend foundation for Connected Social Agents and TikTok Carousel Growth Agent.

problem_log.summary: Problem log captures missing action proposals, connected social storage, TikTok growth-loop models, Postiz reconciliation, and runtime profiles.

root_cause_diagnosis.summary: Root cause is the lack of an approval-gated growth-loop abstraction for social agents.

current_machine.summary: Current machine keeps external accounts, publishing, analytics, and agent actions disconnected.

designed_machine.summary: Designed machine adds connected provider records, snapshots, proposals, growth programs, Postiz analytics helpers, and Hermes profiles.

worst_day_test.summary: Worst-day test covers missing tokens, premature external writes, Postiz ID drift, absent metrics, and model/provider drift.

leading_lagging_metrics.summary: Metrics cover connected assets, proposals, approvals, publications, performance snapshots, conversions, attribution, and execution failures.

owner_date_review.summary: Owner/date/review point are captured for the next live-connection implementation pass.
